Requires: `notebooklm` CLI installed and authenticated. Install: `pip install notebooklm` or see https://github.com/tiangong-ai/notebooklm-cli

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of NotebookLM API skill.

- Manage NotebookLM notebooks via CLI: create, list, and switch between notebooks.
- Add text or URL sources, summarize content, and ask questions within notebooks.
- Generate learning materials: slide decks, quizzes, flashcards, infographics, and reports.
- Download generated artifacts in various formats (e.g., PPTX, PDF).
- Provides example workflows and intent-to-command mapping for common study tasks.

items.description: Family household coordinator. Aggregates Google Calendar, runs a daily morning briefing (weather, schedule, kids meals, school snacks), watches school Gmail for flyers and PDFs, tracks restaurant visits and ratings from receipt photos, manages a per-store grocery list, drafts a weekly meal plan with a Sat/Sun approval cycle, logs sick-kid medication doses, and proactively flags upcoming trips. Optional Club Studio module (off by default) watches Gmail for fitness bookings and can scrape clubstudiofitness.com via Playwright for class recommendations — a real third-party site, disclosed here up front. All family-specific data (names, phones, calendar IDs, meal catalogs, WhatsApp routing) lives in config.json and is 100% config-driven, including Club Studio's WhatsApp targets.

latestVersion.changelog: fix: quiet a persistent secret-scanner false positive in test_keychain_secrets.py by building the fake .env fixture programmatically instead of as a literal KEY=VALUE string (the scanner matches on shape, not semantics, so the 0.4.1 rename didn't clear it). Also: SKILL.md's top-level description now discloses the optional Club Studio module up front, not just in the body.

items.description: Create and format Craft documents reliably via the Craft MCP v2 unified API (craft_write / craft_read). Triggers on any Craft document or note creation, editing, or formatting — including when building project docs, meeting notes, specs, or any structured content in Craft. Ensures correct block structure, ordering, and element syntax on the first pass.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Major update to v2.0.2 with unified API via Craft MCP v2 (`craft_write` / `craft_read`).
- All document creation, editing, and formatting now handled through a single command interface.
- JSON mode strongly recommended for all structured or special content; markdown mode limited to simple text.
- Safer production usage guidance added, with rollback best practices.
- Expanded documentation with detailed block and element mappings, input modes, and indentation/nesting rules.
- Changelog covers new default workflows, code block handling, toggle content, and Craft link resolution.

items.description: Use this skill when generating SVG visual maps from existing YAML map data in a TRPG project. Triggers on: generate SVG maps from YAML, YAML to SVG, 生成SVG地图, 视觉化地图.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of trpg-yaml-to-svg-maps!

- Generates visual SVG maps from existing TRPG YAML map files.
- Reads map node, edge, and region data from maps/ and scenarios/ (initial_map field).
- Outputs a .svg for each YAML map, placed alongside the original file.
- Visual features: rounded rectangles for nodes, labeled edges with arrows, color-differentiated regions, adaptive sizing, and clear Traditional Chinese text.
- Smartly estimates node positions if coordinates are missing.
- Does not modify any original YAML files.

items.description: Use this skill when generating human-readable Markdown scenarios from existing YAML scenario files. Triggers on: generate MD from YAML scenarios, YAML to MD scenario, YAML轉MD劇本.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of trpg-yaml-to-md-scenarios.

- Automatically generates human-readable Markdown scenario files from existing YAML TRPG scenario files.
- Converts structured YAML data into natural, immersive Chinese prose suitable for GMs and players.
- Covers script title, introductory descriptions, scene flow, key NPCs, encounters, map details, objectives/rewards, and GM notes as needed.
- Markdown files are saved alongside their source YAML files, with the same filename and a .md extension.
- Ensures all outputs are in clean, print-friendly Traditional Chinese Markdown, without altering original YAML files.
